title: Persona Evaluation Steps
summary: This module defines a series of command-line steps (B, C, D) for generating persona artifacts, evaluating them through rollouts, and creating persona vectors.

nodes.label: Generate Persona Trait Artifact
nodes.title: Generate Persona Trait Artifact
nodes.description: Creates a structured JSON artifact representing a persona's traits, either from a predefined JSON file or by calling a Vertex AI model.

nodes.label: Run Rollout Evaluation (Step C)
nodes.title: Run Rollout Evaluation (Step C)
nodes.description: Executes a series of rollouts to evaluate the generated persona artifact, optionally using a Vertex AI judge model, and saves the results.

nodes.label: Generate Persona Vectors (Step D)
nodes.title: Generate Persona Vectors (Step D)
nodes.description: Processes the rollout evaluation results to generate numerical persona vectors and a summary, which can be used for further analysis or steering.

nodes.label: Persona Schemas
nodes.title: Persona Schemas
nodes.description: Defines the data structures and validation rules for persona-related artifacts, ensuring consistency across the system.

nodes.label: Vertex AI Platform
nodes.title: Vertex AI Platform
nodes.description: Google Cloud's machine learning platform, used for generating persona artifacts and judging rollout evaluations.

nodes.label: Steering Mechanisms
nodes.title: Steering Mechanisms
nodes.description: Provides functionalities to steer model behavior using persona vectors, influencing responses based on desired traits.

groups.label: Artifact Generation (Step B)
groups.title: Artifact Generation (Step B)
groups.description: Handles the creation of persona trait artifacts, either from local files or via external AI services.

groups.label: Evaluation & Vectorization
groups.title: Evaluation and Vectorization
groups.description: Orchestrates the evaluation of persona artifacts through rollouts and the subsequent generation of persona vectors.
